name: YouTube Kids

intro.Ads: The ads YouTube Kids plays before and during videos.
intro.Privacy: Statistics, tracking pings and permissions. Apart from the voice search button, they change nothing you see.
intro.App: What the app needs to play videos without Google Play services, prompts it shows by itself, and the Sign in tab.

summary: Play YouTube Kids through MicroG-RE without its video ads, watch statistics and tracking pings, without an account.

android.note: YouTube Kids needs Android 7 (minSdk 24). The universal APK has x86_64 libraries, so the emulator runs it natively. The release tries the oldest Android version tested here, the newest stable one and the next one; a pull request the oldest and the newest stable.

checks.screen_shown: The start screen (Get a parent to unlock the app) is showing.
checks.screen_missing: The start screen (Get a parent to unlock the app) didn't show within a minute.

versions.phone_test: set it up signed out and play a few videos on a phone with MicroG-RE: the emulator test only starts the app.
